title: On the Stability and Convergence of Flow Map Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.20674v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow maps are a recent method of probabilistic generation that amortize diffusion trajectories into one-step samplers, unlocking efficient generation. While progress has been made in improving their empirical performance, there is still a lack of understanding behind the mechanisms underlying their success. Specifically, many flow map learning methods employ stop gradient operators as a crucial part of their training target. Adaptive weighting also drastically improves the generation capabilities of flow maps. Although many interpretations have been proposed to support the inclusion of these heuristics, none have analyzed the impact of these assumptions on the training dynamics of flow maps themselves. In this work, we address this issue by providing grounded theory explaining why such tricks are required. translated_title: 关于流映射训练的稳定性与收敛性
translated_abstract: 流映射是近来的一种概率生成方法，它将扩散轨迹摊销为单步采样器，从而实现高效生成。尽管在提升其实证性能方面已取得进展，但对其成功背后的机制仍缺乏理解。具体而言，许多流映射学习方法将停止梯度算子作为其训练目标的关键组成部分。自适应加权也极大地提升了流映射的生成能力。尽管已有许多解释被提出以支持这些启发式技巧的引入，但尚无工作分析这些假设对流映射自身训练动态的影响。在本工作中，我们通过提供有依据的理论来解释为什么需要这些技巧，从而解决了这一问题。通过分析由 MeanFlow 损失和拉格朗日损失所诱导的函数梯度流，我们证明了其收敛到真实流映射……
tldr: 本文通过分析MeanFlow与拉格朗日损失诱导的函数梯度流，首次从理论上解释了流映射训练中停止梯度算子和自适应加权等技巧的必要性，并证明了训练会收敛到真实流映射。
en_tdlr: This paper provides grounded theory explaining why stop-gradient operators and adaptive weighting are necessary in flow map training, and proves convergence to the true flow map by analyzing the functional gradient flow induced by the MeanFlow and Lagrangian losses.
